from pocket_coffea.processor.base import BaseProcessor
import awkward as ak
import numpy as np


class DimuonAnalysisProcessor(BaseProcessor):
    """Minimal dimuon analysis processor for PocketCoffea v0.9.13."""
    
    def process_objects(self, events):
        """Create MuonGood collection with pT > 15 GeV and |eta| < 2.4."""
        muon_selection = (events.Muon.pt > 15) & (np.abs(events.Muon.eta) < 2.4)
        events["MuonGood"] = events.Muon[muon_selection]
        return events
    
    def count_objects(self, events):
        """Store the number of selected muons per event."""
        events["n_muons"] = ak.num(events.MuonGood)
        return events
